captions.text: Most strategy games wait for your move
This galaxy doesn't
NOVA
A real-time game of galactic conquest
No turns. Production ticks, fleets fly and battles resolve on a live clock.
Standing orders keep reinforcements flowing to the front — even while you sleep.
Pick your force — a quarter, half, or everything — and launch.
You get 30 seconds to recall a misclick. After that, the fleet is committed.
A jump gate is a permanent high-speed lane. You set its speed, and can upgrade it later.
Capture one end of an enemy gate and you inherit their highway.
Global comms, private channels — and contracts.
Offer credits for a specific fleet sent from a specific star. Accepting settles both sides in one atomic act.
Every star is on your map. What's parked there is another question.
A spy probe buys you a look. The numbers start going stale the moment you read them.
Two hundred credits destroys a star forever — a dead scar on the map.

scenes.support: Probe shields and nova shields keep the other side honest.

captions.text: Every commander begins with the same resources: one star, 250 ships, 250 credits.
Design one wedge in the map editor and NOVA rotates an exact copy to every player.
Choose your time frame — a lunch-break skirmish or a long campaign.
Private games come with a six-letter code and a QR invite.
NOVA
Play in the browser. Command from your phone.
